paper_title: Getting the most on supernova axions
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_ap (lower edge of excluded band)
notes: SN 1987A bounds on ALP-proton coupling gap (KSVZ benchmark with gan=0). The exclusion is a band; extracted lower edge of cooling bound: 6e-10 for ma<=10 MeV rising to 7e-10 at ~100 MeV. Upper edge of band reaches gap~2.5e-6 (ma<10MeV) and 3.5e-7 (ma~100MeV); KII event bound gap>=3e-7. Combined result excludes gap>=6e-10 for ma<=1 MeV. Pre-analysis hint suggested AxionNeutron but paper clearly constrains proton coupling (gap) with neutron coupling set to zero.
